method: Opened official sources with web tools; Partition.scala method also retrieved directly from the tagged upstream raw source. No broker/PostGIS/PG cluster experiment is implied.

sources.title: PostGIS geography metres and spheroid
sources.supports: Metres for geography; spheroidal default; bbox index prefilter.

sources.title: Kafka 4.1 ELR
sources.supports: New 4.1 clusters default ELR on; feature=0 disables; chapter explicitly diverges for ISR teaching.

sources.title: KafkaProducer 4.1.2
sources.supports: Commit timeout can be unknown; retry the same operation or close, rather than switching to abort.

sources.title: Kafka 4.1.2 Partition.scala
sources.supports: maybeIncrementLeaderHW returns early when under minISR; maximalISR and eligible caught-up waiters mean model must state its simplified replica-set assumption.

sources.title: PostgreSQL18 isolation
sources.supports: Read Committed UPDATE waits then rechecks WHERE; does not generally enforce arbitrary cross-row invariants.

sources.title: PostgreSQL18 row locks
sources.supports: Use explicit row locking and fixed order for a multi-row invariant; retry whole transactions on deadlock.

sources.title: Redis GEOADD
sources.supports: Sorted-set geospatial storage; chosen spherical metric and supported coordinate limits must remain explicit.

sources.title: Kafka4.1.2 OffsetAndMetadata
sources.supports: Leader epoch refers to the last consumed record; a partial batch frontier must not blindly inherit the later poll endpoint epoch. The teaching adapter explicitly omits unknown epoch for a partial checkpoint.

sources.title: Kafka4.1.2 ConsumerRecords
sources.supports: nextOffsets metadata belongs to partitions advanced in this poll, which may differ from partitions containing returned records.
